text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I invited Trainer Kiryuin out for a 
stroll, and as the two of us were walking 
along peacefully—

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Oh? ...Wait, that's.

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
No good! You need to put more spirit into 
it and muscle through that turn with pure 
guts...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes... *pant*, *gasp*... I'm going 
again...!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
You're working hard, aren't you? ...Though 
as a piece of advice:

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It's even written in the Trainer's 
White Paper: "These only hold meaning when 
backed by technique."

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Still, meddling in his methods would also—

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Good grief, pull it together... The next 
race is my final chance, you know.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, Trainer over there, pardon the 
interruption during your training.

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text: Wha-... Huh?! Trainer Kiryuin?!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Please tell me what you truly meant 
by that. What do you mean by 'last 
chance'?

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
W-What do you mean, "what's wrong"... 
Because her grades are terrible, my own 
evaluation is dropping!

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
If Tracen Academy terminates my contract, 
my entire future will—

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
As the trainer who is supposed to guide 
her toward her dream, what kind of burden 
are you placing on your Umamusume?!

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text: Wha...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
This is our last chance? ...Please, do not 
mock me.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
A Trainer's job isn't to force their own 
dreams onto an Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
To those girls, a race is a monumental, 
life-altering event...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: We are here to guide that path.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
The ones entrusted with someone's life 
isn't the Umamusume... it's us!

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text: W-Well, that is...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
...If you call yourself a Trainer, 
shoulder that Umamusume's dream alongside 
her.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
As long as you keep chasing your dream, 
the end will never come.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: ...Surely, to you as well.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
...My sincere apologies for earlier. That 
was quite unsightly of me.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Still... I just couldn't keep quiet about 
it.
choice_data_list: You taught me something very important.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Huh... N-No way!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer <username>, you probably know all about 
that, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Just by watching, I can tell. How deeply 
you truly care for Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
...Still, I am honored that you would say 
so.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Being acknowledged by someone you place 
your trust in really does warm the heart, 
doesn't it?
choice_data_list: You... place your trust in me?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Eh... Ah?! O-Of course! Um, not in any 
weird way, mind you!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Like, as classmates, as Trainers, or as 
friends!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Of course, anything else is totally fine 
too! Just being able to talk like this 
with you is—

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Ah... S-Sorry. Please forget I said 
anything...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Trainer Kiryuin places a great 
deal of trust in her.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
...Not at all. Losing one's temper and 
shouting is merely proof of immaturity.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
This won't do. For Meek's sake as well, I 
need to grow as a Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to go apologize to that trainer 
from earlier for shouting at them……

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure Trainer Kiryuin's sincerity got 
through to them.
